newsitem.title: ZAIRE: U.N. refugee chief arrives in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: U.N. refugee chief arrives in Zaire.

text.p: U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees Sadako Ogata arrived in Zaire on Friday at the start of a visit to Central Africa's conflict-ridden Great Lakes region.
Ogata, who has called for a political aand security solution to the Tutsi-led revolt in east Zaire, was due to meet the Zairean authorities and relief agency representatives, relief officials said.
Her visit coincided with an escalation of fighting in the east which has trapped several hundred thousand refugees in different parts of the war zone.
